description: Non-material amendment to planning permission ref. 78935/APP/2025/2287, dated 16-01-26 (Creation of 5no. self-contained flats with associated cycle and bin storage, following the change of use of first floor from office (Class E) to residential (Class C3), the erection of a two storey rear extension and alterations to rear building at first floor level and the retention and reconfiguration of the Class E unit at ground floor level with alterations to fenestration.) to reconfigure the commercial unit at the ground floor and relocate the cycle storage.
decision_conditions: Condition 2 (Accordance with Approved Plans) attached to planning permission reference 78935/APP/2025/2287, dated 16-01-26, is amended to the following:
The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out except in complete accordance with the details shown on the submitted drawings
and shall thereafter be retained/maintained for as long as the development remains in existence.
To ensure the development complies with the provisions of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 1 (2012), Part 2 (2020) and the London Plan (2021).

Notwithstanding the non-material amendment hereby approved, all conditions attached to planning permission ref. 78935/APP/2025/2287, dated 16 January 2026, shall remain in full force and effect and must be discharged and/or complied with in accordance with that permission, except for Condition 2, which is superseded by the approved plans condition above.
